title: Raw Intake Observation Envelopes
purpose: Staged representation of all physical Lab 2 observation records, preserving source identity, source row, source hash, parse status, and raw payload for complete accounting and provenance.

columns.name: record_id
columns.meaning: Logical record identifier supplied by the source when available.

columns.name: event_time
columns.meaning: Original event timestamp text from the source prior to normalization.

columns.name: ingest_time
columns.meaning: Original ingestion timestamp text from the source prior to normalization.

columns.name: reading
columns.meaning: Original source reading prior to numeric parsing and validation.

columns.name: unit
columns.meaning: Original measurement unit supplied by the source.

columns.name: operator_email
columns.meaning: Operator email field supplied by the synthetic source dataset.

columns.name: source_object
columns.meaning: S3 object location of the original source record.

columns.name: source_row
columns.meaning: Physical row number within the source object.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.meaning: SHA-256 digest of the original source object.

columns.name: parse_ok
columns.meaning: Indicates whether the source record was parsed successfully.

columns.name: raw_payload
columns.meaning: Preserved raw representation of the physical source record.
